annotations.title: Read the LINE account and its webhook

description: The connected LINE Official Account: its name and LINE id, HOW MANY FRIENDS it has, how many of them a broadcast can reach and how many blocked it (LINE’s own figures, about a day old; unknown is reported as unknown, never zero), and whether LINE is sending the account’s messages to Hermoso: the webhook address LINE holds, whether it is Hermoso’s, and whether the Use webhook switch is on. This is the answer to “how many LINE friends do we have” and the first thing to read when LINE messages are not arriving; it lists what is left to switch on in the LINE console. Pass test:true to have LINE call the address and report what it got (LINE allows 60 tests an hour). Free, 0 credits.

test.description: have LINE test the webhook address and report the result
